question: In the word HYPNOTIC, each letter of the word is changed to the letter immediately succeeding it in the English alphabetical order and then the new group of letters thus formed is rearranged according to the English alphabetical order. Which letter is second to the left in the new rearranged group of letters?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given word: HYPNOTIC,

Each letter of the word is changed to the letter immediately succeeding it in the English alphabetical order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b1898459e8a8892aa696925b31ff761043e0b595135249534d72ea97df14ef9.png] 

Thus letter** I** is second to the left in the new rearranged group of letters.

Hence, the correct answer is "I".
